title: Reciprocate
summary: RECIP'ROCATE, verb intransitive [Latin reciproco.] To act interchangeably; to alternate. One brawny smith the puffing bellows plies, and draws and blows reciprocating air. RECIP'ROCATE, verb transitiv

inlines.v: RECIP'ROCATE, verb intransitive [Latin reciproco.] To act interchangeably; to alternate. One brawny smith the puffing bellows plies, and draws and blows reciprocating air. RECIP'ROCATE, verb transitive To exchange; to interchange; to give and return mutually; as, to reciprocate favors.
